notes.title: Enhanced DEMO
notes.notes:
This month, we revised the Demo, slightly lowering the difficulty level to make it more enjoyable. Additionally, we removed the limit of three attempts for the County competition. Now, you can try it as many times as you want—just head to the airport located south of the County and get a plane ticket to the racetrack. The competition is very challenging, and only the most skilled players can hope to come in first, but don’t be discouraged—the more you try, the better you'll become!
The map has also been improved: only points of interest for the Demo are highlighted, and information relevant only to the full game has been removed, making it easier to read.
If you have any suggestions, let us know in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/d1f7c41adb086b9764a2c63855d99e54506505e8.png[/img]

notes.title: A little bit of aliens and a little bit of cows
notes.notes:
I'm actively working on the central map missions, particularly on the alien hunting one. Since it didn't seem challenging enough, I decided to add, besides the aliens to catch, a flying saucer that drops live cows all around the player to hinder them. Magically, the cows won't get hurt, but your car will soon need repairs! Is this a good idea? Do you have more interesting suggestions to propose? Let me know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/6f5eea7d1e81bcec6b6f956bac57cf05160c58aa.png[/img]

notes.title: Seven Tracks for Seven Days!
notes.notes:
Have you tried the County Competition available in the demo? Did you enjoy it? Here's the news: I’ve decided to develop seven unique tracks, each set in a different environment, all accessible from the airport near the southern border.  
Why seven tracks? Well, one will be available each day of the week. When you visit the airport, you’ll see the day’s destination displayed on the departures board, so you can decide whether to take off or not.  
The difficulty of these competitions will remain high, so it’s advisable to participate only when you’ve become skilled enough at driving your car.  
If you have suggestions or would like to leave me feedback, you can also fill out the form available in the demo. Thanks for your support!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/5f70d6d18aac2ae51a0f824d247eb2705b9869c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/efa0956227cccc7774c5bdea369ec16bde19adfa.png[/img]

notes.title: New Demo, with a new level available
notes.notes:
In September, the first version of the Saddle Up and Drive Demo was launched. To make the experience more varied and fun, I decided to introduce the possibility of playing the external race, but only a limited number of times, just to give a taste of what can be found in the full game (though there will be much more, of course!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/bd6202a50ffb7889acd93b51706e177726e3f410.png[/img]

As for the development of the full game, there’s big news. I had already hinted that the main level of the game is the County, located in the center of the world of Saddle Up and Drive and the starting point of every game (you always start at Uncle's house). This central level has three borders: one to the east, one to the south, and one to the west. The eastern border allows access to a vast snowy area, currently under development, which will contain several missions and will have the same gameplay as the central level. In the south, I plan to make a map that leads to the sea, but it's still in the planning stages. Meanwhile, the western area will be procedurally generated through an algorithm. This is a large area, where we will have forest zones, residential areas, and the city center (the entire level will essentially be one large city). Do you have any suggestions for me? At the moment, I'm working on the algorithm and graphical elements, but I haven’t decided what kind of mission to include in a level like this. Let me know your ideas!

notes.title: WE ARE READY FOR SEPTEMBER 10th!
notes.notes:
Here we are! The demo is finally ready, and it will be released on the 10th of this month. What will you be able to do in this Demo? You'll have just one car available, which you'll need to drive to the only distillery and buy some goods to resell. As soon as you fill the trunk, the police will be alerted and will try to stop you to seize the load, and you'll have to rush to reach the buyer before your car is demolished by law enforcement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/7a8a1cafbae263ab90182c61a0545351088b9ab7.png[/img]

The buyer will always appear in different spots on the map, so there will be many different landscapes to speed through. Just remember to repair your car at the garages found in the various villages between races!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/c533bacf15c9955a93ee3d6b6cbf4f74f7e7df9b.png[/img]

If you explore the game area well, you'll find several characters who will show you what the full game will offer in the future.
Another important event: from September 16th to 23rd, we will be present with the Saddle Up and Drive demo at the Steam Airplanes, Trains, and Automobiles Festival. What better chance to try this game?

P.S.: Want to make sure you play correctly? I've published a brief manual, take a look!n manuale breve, dacci un'occhiata!

notes.title: WE'RE ALMOST THERE!
notes.notes:
Here in Italy, in August, everyone goes on vacation to relax. Not me! I've been working and am still working on the Demo of *Saddle Up and Drive* day and night!
What's new? Graphically, I've added new elements to the environment to make the landscape more varied and complete. Specifically, I've added new cacti and trees, eagles in flight, trash bins in cities, and dinosaur fossils in the middle of the desert.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/62e99d82e0a22f73446448a893641cb6739c5abc.png[/img]
The distilleries' UI has been completely redesigned, making it much smoother to use with a controller.
I've also modified the County Competition; now opponents can be taken out if the impact is too violent, but the difficulty level remains quite high—it's really hard to finish first.
As announced last month, I will release the Demo on September 10th. I invite everyone to try it out and give me feedback so I can perfect the final game according to your suggestions.

notes.title: DEMO COMING SOON!!!
notes.notes:
The demo version of Saddle Up and Drive is almost ready! 

It's scheduled for release in early September, just enough time to add a few more details and we'll be set!

First of all, I want to thank everyone who gave me their valuable suggestions, which have greatly helped me in growing Saddle Up and Drive. Keep it up!

More news? Lots and lots! First and foremost, I've made another leap in quality regarding graphics, here’s a list of the work done this month:
[list]
[*] Applied a new post-processing effect that generates the 'Outline' effect on all objects in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/6f030eece0a9db07cb3b89527e98d56eb85631a3.png[/img]
[*] All buildings in the game have had a complete makeover: higher definition textures, 3D tiles on roofs, windows with dynamic lighting (they light up at night). Some buildings have been completely redesigned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/8c0dc55fd796b38c84418f4c30bee4b48911595d.png[/img]
[*] New details on the terrain: fallen trees, new vegetation (including prickly pears, various bushes, trees), rocks, and stones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/ee3ad2c5b69e0714bb369ed66cb3e258864fdb40.png[/img]
[*] A baseball field, because why not?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/8cb5c6fd310c54ddedde1392967f78b98c3869ef.png[/img]
[/list]

And then? I've revised the police algorithm again. Now, police cars will try to avoid obstacles like houses and rocks and will actively seek new paths to catch you.

What’s cooking now? Continuous improvement, both in graphics and code optimization, to make Saddle Up and Drive more beautiful and fun!

P.S.: We now also have an author's page, take a look!

notes.title: IMPROVED TEXTURES AND NEW DETAILS
notes.notes:
This month we have reviewed all the game terrain textures. We upgraded from low-resolution textures (512x512) to significantly better resolution textures (4096x4096), increasing the graphic quality.
The same work has been done on all the textures of the trees and bushes in the game.
Additionally, some details have been added, such as the urban power grid and some new buildings, like the new town hall of the village of Old Oak.
We will also release a Beta test this month, scheduled for the weekend of June 21st, to gather all your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/b05c144b0edfc2393da8e391af7ed2d9bac69d32.png[/img]

notes.title: New Open Beta scheduled for June 21, 22, and 23, 2024
notes.notes:
We did it! Thanks to your valuable contribution, we have refined the game and resolved all the detected bugs. Now we are ready for a new Beta, planned for June 21, 22, and 23.
What's new? First of all, we optimized the traffic (denser and more efficient), then we introduced new vehicles and new vegetation. Moreover, the syrup seller has been moved significantly closer to the starting point for quicker action and reduced chances of getting lost on the map.
Your feedback is very valuable, feel free to communicate your suggestions, they will all be taken into consideration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/232951ce8e639d7198a01276e900ea37ba22759f.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW VEGETATION, NEW CARS, AND VARIOUS OPTIMIZATIONS
notes.notes:
We have concluded the first Beta, and we have gathered some interesting information, discovered some bugs, and received very useful suggestions.
This month, we focused on resolving all the issues encountered, all bugs have been fixed, and the code has been optimized by reducing the complexity of some geometric calculations.
The traffic system has also been revised, creating a new set of skins for the existing models and introducing completely new vehicles. The vehicle physics calculations have also been perfected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/232951ce8e639d7198a01276e900ea37ba22759f.png[/img]
From a landscaping perspective, we have designed new cacti and bushes in various colors, but this is just the beginning, as our idea is to continuously enrich the game environment and make it as varied and detailed as possible.
We plan to launch a new Beta in June, this time open, where anyone can access and give us feedback, with any suggestions.
Anyone who wants to contribute by reporting bugs or sending us suggestions can do so freely at any time in the 'Discussions' section of this Steam page.
Remember to follow us to stay updated!

notes.title: Now we have bumper cars!
notes.notes:
Now we have bumper cars!

This new mission allows you to make extra money quite easily, it's ideal when everything else goes wrong. By paying the entrance fee, you need to eliminate all opponents (they also eliminate each other). You can repair your car on the track by picking up spare parts boxes that will appear randomly at certain points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/e110975450de8b29f58eb8bce050a326c8a54c00.png[/img]

We have enhanced the gaming experience by creating 3 cinematic cameras instead of just one, with different angles that allow you to fully enjoy the most spectacular jumps you'll make with your favorite car! But, since not everyone might like this interruption of gameplay, we have introduced an option to disable these cameras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/ea9f3343d14a606bb5419568541a56d12460965e.png[/img]

And for the next month? A new mission: the treasure hunt!

notes.title: New missions and new maps!
notes.notes:
The new year has started with a desire to go all out! The study of the firefighters' mission was quite complex, but after countless efforts, we managed to successfully develop and test this new part of the game.

First of all, we specifically created a map: we asked ourselves, where do we set this mission? We decided on a beautiful natural park, full of wild deer, in the center of which, of course, there is an oil refinery on fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/dee8e01c38987e6b0cfd67fce58c70b3f7df053f.png[/img]

The real challenge was defining the controls, which led us to opt for blocking the fire truck when using the water jet to extinguish fires.

As for the gaming experience, now vehicles explode in a very spectacular way: impacts and forces acting on the involved bodies have been improved, and particle effects have been applied to project debris, pieces of cars, wheels...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/5a2617b781202d2273ca200e60d36909cdea6bd5.gif[/img]

What's cooking now? For the next month, we want to develop a demolition derby, which will take place in a separate arena, where you can defeat a bunch of fierce competitors. What do you think?

notes.title: New vehicles and a new mission: the ambulance driver!
notes.notes:
Here we are! Even in December, we worked full time to enrich Saddle Up and Drive.

As planned, we introduced, developed, and thoroughly debugged the new ambulance driver mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/92f1d193c16634c814c0fa8208ab9a2fa457302b.png[/img]

What does it consist of? First of all, you have to go to the county hospital, then a nurse will ask if you want to lend a hand to the community (in exchange for a generous reward, of course...).

If we accept, we'll find ourselves driving an ambulance with which we'll have to rescue a person within a time limit and take them to the emergency room entrance of the hospital.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/0c64236eee8c3fbe44323f4d971624f5621f556d.png[/img]

What's fun about this mission? Well, since traffic won't be particularly cooperative, you can kindly make your way by smashing every vehicle that obstructs your path, creating chaos and destruction everywhere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/b9196680fbc52a6bd6aca794bd5094b51725fbb0.gif[/img]

In the traffic, we've also introduced ambulances and fire trucks, further enriching the variety of vehicles in the game and creating new explosive situations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/14153d3826f831f4abd16c941ac2fa2fed9902cd.png[/img]

For January, we have a new mission in the works, which will take place on a side map, specifically in the county's natural park: the firefighters!
How would you set up a mission like this?

Your advice and suggestions are always welcome!
Happy holidays!

notes.title: November Announcement!
notes.notes:
Well yes! As anticipated last month, we've devoted heart and soul to the design of 6 new missions, which will be added to the existing 8 missions, not to mention the syrup smuggling business, always very lucrative, although far from risk-free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/ad61752bc18336654b1ff7746c110007e0b66152.gif[/img]

The first extra mission we've developed is... the bikers' bar!
How does it work? Simple, reach the bikers' bar and challenge them in an arena in the desert, where you duke it out with sticks: whoever stays in the saddle wins the entire prize pool!
Moreover, regardless of the mission, a gang of fierce bikers circulates daily on the main map, which is better to avoid, lest you end up with your car reduced to scrap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/53218dc098f9104468801f9292621517d221731d.png[/img]

The mission for next month? Something good: drive the ambulance to the hospital and take patients to the emergency room, isn't that in tune with the Christmas spirit?
Of course, you'll find yourself driving like crazy in the midst of rather disrespectful traffic for those in a hurry...

And now, to work!

notes.title: Announcement for October!
notes.notes:
This month, we have completed the development of the 'Homemade Syrup' smuggling missions, including all the characters and three varieties of available syrup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/09e1c8f91bf1d8312f040c3bf069b93263e22ce1.png[/img]

The value of a syrup cargo to be smuggled has been adjusted according to the difficulty of reaching the seller. Therefore, if you want to make more substantial profits in a single run, you'll need to take more risks, traveling longer routes filled with police officers ready to catch you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/6a62cf65c0b02edbc7f25496570eea9dace8ca64.png[/img]

As if the police weren't enough to hinder business (and they are!), we've introduced other smugglers who, not at all pleased with competition in their territory, will go the extra mile to further complicate the honest work of the independent smuggler.

Speaking of smugglers, we've added a group of traffickers flying an airplane across the map. It's quite challenging to spot them, but if you do, try to follow them. The pilots are so busy looking for a distant landing strip away from prying eyes that they might lose part of their cargo, all to our advantage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/2294d2652c00a555f8a1b09be4b57e2f3b332c12.png[/img]

November is approaching, and we're very excited to introduce some side missions, active every day of the week, allowing you to earn some money by helping the community, so nothing illegal (as long as you don't destroy everything and everyone during your work activity)!

See you next month!

notes.title: September Announcement!
notes.notes:
It is with great pleasure that we announce the September updates. It has been a very intense month in terms of game development, as we have been working on multiple fronts simultaneously.

As previously mentioned, we have improved the police AI, making pursuits more balanced, exciting, and anything but easy. The introduction of roadblocks requires greater focus on driving: if you get distracted during a getaway, you risk having your car wrecked in no time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/3bb7916c8a5be2ac017baae26582207f4d363ff7.png[/img]

We've also upgraded the logic for traffic flow: now, in case of a traffic jam, drivers will autonomously try to maneuver their way out of the congested area, unless 'someone' causes further disruption...

The composition of the soundtracks has required (and will continue to require!) many hours of work. Our goal is to create a vast musical repertoire to enrich the game's atmosphere and make the overall experience rich and evocative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/6a02d790361ead62fe4c754887ee32ad335f3313.png[/img]

Our target for October is to conclude the development of the 'Homemade Syrup' smuggling missions, including all specially designed characters and diversifying the various types of products based on the difficulty of reaching the buyer or the unexpected obstacles that may be encountered.

Have any suggestions or questions? Feel free to write in the comments; they are always welcome!

notes.title: August Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here are the August updates regarding the development of Saddle Up & Drive. This month has been very busy; we focused on the complete translation of the user interface, game menus, and all dialogues in the intended languages, and we have achieved the set goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/98c9137e4cadb1fed55151502b23a03afe104e08.gif[/img]

We have also finished the programming related to the Gamepad. Now, once the game is launched, it is entirely manageable and playable without a mouse and keyboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/f63d6b6cf6598428ed556a5b89a0c6ad926b9167.png[/img]

Every day, we dedicate time to enrich the landscape more and more by introducing new elements, such as new buildings and new vehicles. The latest creation is the fuel transport truck, a vehicle you'd better not rear-end, as it will explode very easily, damaging your car. However, it works very well for evading the police by making the right maneuvers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278799/3f06457fd31a333abdfb1e914eb2c6bed04a005d.gif[/img]

Objective for the next month: finalize the AI for the police and the traffic on the roads. Stay tuned!

notes.title: July Announcement!
notes.notes:
July Announcement!

We are pleased to publish the official DevLog of Saddle Up & Drive on this Steam page. Every month, we will release updates regarding the game's development progress, and we will make sure to gather your always appreciated suggestions and respond to your curiosities.
As of today, Saddle Up & Drive is in a highly advanced stage of development. The gameplay mechanics have been completed, as well as the setting (it is an Open World of approximately 50 km2, concerning the first map, which will be the only one available at launch. There are three more maps planned, of the same size, which will be connected to the original map to the west, south, and east borders).
The landscape consists of several small towns connected by countless highways and dirt roads, in environments ranging from the American desert to mountain forests, from the countryside to swamps, with rivers, lakes, canyons, and many iconic locations and buildings to discover.
Follow us to stay updated and share your opinion, as it is very important to us!
